Class ArtifactorySearch

java.lang.Object
org.owasp.dependencycheck.data.artifactory.ArtifactorySearch
@ThreadSafe public class ArtifactorySearch extends Object
Class of methods to search Artifactory for hashes and determine Maven GAV from there.

Data classes copied from JFrog's artifactory-client-java project.

  • Method Details

    • search

      public List<MavenArtifact> search(Dependency dependency) throws IOException
      Searches the configured Central URL for the given hash (MD5, SHA1 and SHA256). If the artifact is found, a MavenArtifact is populated with the GAV.
      Parameters:
      dependency - the dependency for which to search (search is based on hashes)
      Returns:
      the populated Maven GAV.
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if the specified artifact is not found
      IOException - if it's unable to connect to the specified repository

    • preflightRequest

      public boolean preflightRequest()
      Performs a pre-flight request to ensure the Artifactory service is reachable.
      Returns:
      true if Artifactory could be reached; otherwise false.
